title: Egg Salad
description: A large-batch egg salad of coarsely ground eggs mixed with Mrs. Dash, sweet relish and mayonnaise.

steps.instruction: Coarsely grind eggs in food processor with Mrs. Dash.
Combine remaining ingredients and mix with spatula. Enough sweet relish should be added to just taste and enough mayo to make smooth.

notes: Timing estimated; not stated in original.
The original does not say how the eggs are cooked; hard-boiled, peeled eggs are presumably intended.
Transcription note: Yield not stated in original; about 3 quarts estimated from 36 eggs plus 2 cups of relish and mayonnaise.
